featured_items.title: 样例竞品履约与物流心智进入竞品观察
featured_items.display_title: 样例竞品履约与物流心智进入竞品观察
featured_items.original_text:
Please how can I send an email to 
@Officialspeedaf who have their email address? I need to explain to them that their riders would stay somewhere and start messaging you to come to so so place to receive your packages, one even threatened me. Do I have to write to Temu too? Cos why I’m buying from Temu is cos it’s doorstep delivery and this has been going on for a while. I can’t be told something is doorstep delivery and riders should be threatening me to leave my business to come and collect.
featured_items.translation_zh: 请问我怎样才能给 @Officialspeedaf 发邮件，谁有他们的邮箱地址？我需要向他们说明，他们的骑手会待在某个地方，然后开始给你发消息，让你到某某地方去收包裹，其中一个甚至威胁我。我也必须写信给 Temu 吗？因为我在 Temu 买东西的原因就是因为它是送货上门，而这种情况已经持续了一段时间。不能告诉我这是送货上门，结果骑手却威胁我，让我放下自己的生意去取货。
